column1: # XLivelessAddon signature golden - the original scan list, in effective order.
# Captured from the pre-modular source at git revision dcc4f31 (the import from
# OpenPreCEPatch, before the .ixx split). Provenance per row is the original
# file:line. `target` is the module interface unit that owns the scan today;
# `-` marks an occurrence that the refactor consolidated into another row (see
# the `note` column). Generated once with .scratch/parity/derive_golden.py and
# reviewed; tools/signature_parity.py is the test that consumes it.
# The `signature` column is the canonical byte sequence: space-separated units,
# `?` for a wildcard and two hex digits for a byte. Hooking.Patterns ignores
# everything else (including whitespace), so this is the form that decides which
# bytes are actually matched; the check compares this sequence, not the text.
